rules.title: PEP 8 with Ruff
rules.text: Follow PEP 8 and use Ruff for linting and formatting.

rules.title: Type hints
rules.text: Add type hints to all function signatures and run mypy or pyright.

rules.title: pathlib
rules.text: Use pathlib for filesystem paths and context managers for resources.

rules.title: Dataclasses or Pydantic
rules.text: Model structured data with dataclasses or Pydantic, not loose dicts.

rules.title: uv for environments
rules.text: Manage dependencies and virtual environments with uv, commit uv.lock and install with uv sync --locked in CI.

rules.title: pytest
rules.text: Write tests with pytest, using fixtures and parametrize instead of loops.

rules.title: Specific exceptions
rules.text: Catch specific exceptions, never bare except.

rules.title: f-strings
rules.text: Use f-strings for formatting, but not for building SQL or log messages with sensitive data.

rules.title: Readable comprehensions
rules.text: Use comprehensions for simple transforms and loops when logic is complex.

rules.title: logging module
rules.text: Use the logging module with a module-level logger, not print.

rules.title: Protocols for interfaces
rules.text: Use Protocol or ABC to define interfaces and keep concrete types out of signatures.

rules.title: asyncio discipline
rules.text: Do not mix blocking calls into async code; use asyncio.to_thread for unavoidable blocking work.
